evidence_status.verified_existing_artifact: The rounded value agrees with an existing CSV or JSON result in this repository.
evidence_status.provided_summary_unverified: The value was supplied in the study summary but no corresponding raw or aggregate pipeline artifact is currently included.
evidence_status.provided_summary_conflicts_with_grid_art: The supplied summary reports 7.0700 +/- 0.0544 for Beauty, while results/reproducibility/grid_summary.json stores a single-seed mean NDCG of 7.1062 for lr=0.2 and rank_weight=10. Both are retained without treating them as equivalent.

protocol_note: The ItemKNN values in itemknn_comparison.csv are verified against the earlier outer-evaluation artifacts. They differ from the later inner-validation-selected outputs under results/knn_hybrid_selection and must not be relabeled as those tuned outputs.
heteroembed_note: HeteroEmbed values are imported as supplied and remain unverified until the dedicated tuning pipeline writes its per-seed and aggregate artifacts.
cafe_note: CAFE values for Cell Phones, Clothing, and CDs & Vinyl are imported as supplied and remain unverified in this snapshot.
